query:
SELECT COALESCE(r.status, '') AS "status!",
                   a.message_id AS "message_id!",
                   COALESCE(a.content, '') AS "content!"
              FROM activity.voice_feedback_requests r
              JOIN activity.voice_feedback_responses a ON a.request_id = r.id
             WHERE r.user_id = 100
             ORDER BY a.id
             LIMIT 1
